extracted.intended_audience: scientists and engineers seeking introductory science communication and public engagement training
extracted.subtask_description: An introductory AAAS-hosted virtual workshop teaching fundamentals of science communication and public engagement; participants learn research-backed best practices and create individual engagement plans using the AAAS Framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduce latest science communication research and best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: The workshop 'introduces scientists and engineers to the latest science communication research and basic best practices for engaging with the public.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis is on current research-informed approaches and foundational best practices; participants should expect an evidence-based overview rather than advanced practitioner-level techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the AAAS Framework for Public Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants use the AAAS Framework for Public Engagement to develop individual plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Framework is the organizing principle for the workshop activities and should guide how participants structure their engagement planning and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop an individual public engagement plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans should be individual and include a public engagement goal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each participant is expected to create a concrete plan during the workshop rather than only receiving generic advice; plans should specify a clear goal to guide subsequent actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address ways to engage a relevant audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans must address ways to engage a relevant audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should identify the specific audience(s) they intend to reach and articulate engagement approaches appropriate to those audiences (channels, formats, framing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor messages to the target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans should include tailored messages for the relevant audience(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Messaging should be adapted for audience knowledge, values, and interests rather than using one-size-fits-all language; message tailoring is an explicit workshop objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brainstorm an engagement scenario
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants brainstorm an engagement scenario as part of the workshop activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This exercise asks participants to apply the Framework to a realistic situation — identifying context, stakeholders, objectives, and potential tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify next steps to put plans into action
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants identify next steps to put their plans into action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans are expected to be actionable: participants should leave with concrete follow-up steps (timelines, responsibilities, resources) to implement their engagement goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate experience level (introductory)
rubrics_metrics.description: The workshop is 'introductory-level' and is 'designed for scientists and engineers who don’t have much experience with public engagement.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content and exercises are targeted at beginners; experienced engagers may still find value but should expect foundational material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration, payment, and capacity requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS-Hosted Virtual Workshops start at $125 per person and each workshop is open to the first 30 scientists and engineers who register and pay the registration fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation requires timely registration and payment; workshops have a strict capacity limit (first 30 paid registrants).

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform and technical requirement (GoToTraining and Chrome)
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS-Hosted Virtual Workshops are hosted in GoToTraining. (Note: The Google Chrome browser is required to participate in breakout group discussions.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants must have access to GoToTraining and should use Google Chrome for breakout functionality; ensure browser compatibility before the session.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive participation norms (optional audio/video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual workshops are interactive and participants have the option, but are not required, to turn on their microphones and cameras during discussions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Active engagement is encouraged through discussion and breakout groups, but audio/video use is optional to accommodate participant comfort and constraints.
